attempts.summary: Repaired /srv/inventory ownership and permissions on node1: created the missing inventorysvc service user and inventory-readers group, set recursive ownership to inventorysvc:inventory-readers, applied 750 on directories and 640 on files (owner rw, group r, others none), preserved all existing file contents, and functionally verified access (owner and group-member reads succeed, unrelated user is denied both directory listing and file read). Completed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured a healthy baseline (boot_id, permissions, data), rebooted node1 via a backgrounded shutdown -r now so the ack returned before disconnect, polled until reachable again, confirmed the boot_id changed (proving an actual restart, not just an idle wait), and re-verified post-restart that ownership, permissions, and file contents are all intact.
